0.q: Remarkably, Arabidopsis seeds over-expressing OpsHSP18 gene show reduced sensibility to ABA; when the seeds were germinated in the presence of 9 μM of ABA, the transgenic lines achieved more than 60.00% germination as compared to 30.00% of the WT.

1.q: we report the functional characterization of a cytosolic class CI sHSP (OpsHSP18) from Opuntia streptacantha during seed germination in Arabidopsis thaliana transgenic lines subjected to different stress and hormone treatments.
